composition_mechanism.type: direct handoff x2 (stance->walk, then walk->lower), no scripted blend
composition_mechanism.description: Three SimHexapodJointWalkEnv instances, one per role's own exact recorded cfg-set (each role's bus.write_speed/safety.max_delta_q_deg/goal.joint_action_bias_* differ and are cached at env __init__, so one live env can't hot-swap them). At each handoff tick the raw physical state (qpos/qvel/ctrl/act + SafetyLayer._last_safe slew memory) is copied from the outgoing env into a freshly-reset incoming env (fresh plant-frame goal/tilt/height anchors via the established 'reanchor_keep_state' trick), then mj_forward + a rebuilt observation. No joint trajectory is scripted at either handoff.
